posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I think it would be better if you could edit your messages, we are not in a chat.
From what I see in the screenshot of the folder, the project is inside an external or virtualized device. I tested it and it worked perfectly, but we can assume that your version of RMMV does not have permission to read files directly from other drives, since the test player may be running with a non-admin user.
Try copying the project folder to "MVGames" by navigating to "Documents", run command (Window + R):
Code:
%userprofile%\Documents\MVGames
In RPG Maker navigate to that same folder and open the project from there and then test
Another issue could be that you recently installed Windows 11. Maybe the ISO you used is not the official one downloaded from Microsoft's website, which could have corrupted some files. Verify that all updates have been downloaded
As a last resort, go to
Steam
and verify the integrity of the RMMV files.
Library -> RPG Maker MV ->
Gear icon
-> Properties

probably not as you lose all animation (unless convert that).
but while it's the Actor.json file, try this one for testing.
create a new project => draw something => playtest.
does that work,  drop in your Actor.json file inside the data only.
and test it.
if it works, copy all datafiles, and everything to the new project.
insert the plugins and plugin.js only to get all your setups back.
this should work by than on your playtest.
most uses nwjs 0.29 as default, you might as well upgrade this to
a version of 0.48.4 or better if you like with pixi 4.8.9 (or better), but
for that, be carefull on that if it doesn't break everyhting.
do the NWJS upgrade later to comfirm the new project is working good
without errors.
